admission_rule: distance-bounded: Euclidean-to-nearest-train in scaled Magpie space <= 90th percentile of pool distances (recomputed PER SPLIT); then near-duplicate dedup. Pre-registered from error-vs-distance analysis (error flat within this bound).
physics_channel: Voigt-Reuss-Hill G from elemental moduli (Channel B)
digest_rule: PRIMARY control: shared 8-cluster digest (counts + best-G); rank by count; sample least-explored half; reads counts only, no optimization.
representation: two parallel: Magpie vector (GP/oracle/distance) + composition dict (digest clustering, mutation).
